concept: Chic modern salon for My 1 Hair Solution: a soft plum/violet primary paired with warm champagne-gold, set against creamy blush-white backgrounds with gentle warm-gray ink. Elegant, polished, and feminine yet broad in appeal.
contrastNotes: All required ratios hold (WCAG-AA). ink #2C2530 on bg #FBF6F7 = 13.88:1 (>=7). ink-soft #5C525F on bg = 6.94:1 (>=4.5). white on primary #7A4A8C = 6.59:1 (>=4.5). primary on bg = 6.16:1 (>=3). Extras: white on primary-dark #5C3469 = 9.77:1; ink on surface #FFFFFF = 14.85:1; ink on surface-alt = 12.51:1; accent (champagne-gold) #9C7A33 on bg = 3.74:1 (AA for large/decorative text and as a non-text accent).
